raw_occurrence_identity.raw_full_body:
THAT Council Direct staff to provide notice that Council will consider issuing
             Development Variance Permit No. DVP26-0001 for 1436 Pinehurst Place with the
             following variance:

                     a.   THAT Section 3.21.03(4)(a) be varied to increase the allowable height of a
                          fence along the rear lot line from 1.8 m (5.9 ft) to 3.4 m (11.1 ft).
